title: Publish: a seed load right after publishPackageDrafts can hit OBJECT_NOT_FOUND for objects the data door serves a minute later — the registry write-through swallows a registerObject failure
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named producer, reproduced twice on cloud staging by the AI build path. Measured by the dev of objectstack-ai/cloud#4446 (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4454, report on cloud#4446 comment 6843064792) at framework pin `c5758b0d`. Cloud ships a bounded, honest recovery: seeds that did not land are loaded again once their tables answer. The race itself is framework-side, so it lands here (cross-repo rule 1).

## 维护者速读

托管上 AI 搭建应用时，发布显示「成功」，但紧接着写入示例数据时，引擎报「找不到这张表」。一分钟后再查，这些表都能正常访问。cloud 先做了「等表能用后再补写」的兜底。根本原因在框架：发布时往注册表写对象失败了，但这个错误被吞掉了，只打了一条警告。

## What happens

- Staging repros: `os-1959re` conversation `conv_4f2a19ba`, and `os-4e4qa4` conversation `conv_a09f45a2`. The publish answered `published`. Its seed load then got `Object '<name>' not found` from `objectNotFoundError` in `resolveObjectName` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-secrets-and-routing.ts` ~134-140). The data door served the same tables with 200 a minute later.
- Publish Phase 2's registry write-through swallows `registerObject` failures with `console.warn` (metadata-protocol `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` ~166-169). That is the likely window.
- **Not reproduced** on an in-memory hosted kernel in three variants (with and without the real `metadata:reloaded` announce). The sequence was a refused first publish that rolled back, then a successful re-publish.

## Expected

When `publishPackageDrafts` answers `published`, every published object resolves on the running engine. Otherwise the publish answers that it did not fully register; it never says `published` silently. A registry write-through failure is loud, not swallowed.

## Acceptance

A test reproduces a registry write-through failure during publish and pins the loud answer. After a successful publish, an immediate seed load resolves every published object.

Dedupe: `publishPackageDrafts seed OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, `registry write-through swallowed`: no open issue.
